frozen_candidate_root_contribution: The strongest single candidate contribution is "being unbound / released from bondage or constraint — free." It is demonstrably present in two clusters on internal evidence: (a) al-Hurr / al-Hurr in 2:178, where the free person is explicitly set against al-'abd (the slave), and (b) the Form II tahriru raqabah cluster (4:92 x3, 58:3, 5:89) plus muharraran (3:35), where the act is making a slave-neck free / dedicating-releasing a child to God. Across these 8 occurrences the residue "release from bondage" survives after subtracting form and participants. However, this candidate is NOT present in the remaining 7 occurrences (heat: 16:81, 35:21, 9:81 x2; silk: 22:23, 35:33, 76:12), so it is not a universal contribution.

internal_discovery.plain_explanation: The root ح ر ر in the Quran breaks into three semantic islands that share only the three consonants, not a single demonstrable meaning: HEAT (al-harr, al-harur, harr — garments that protect from heat, scorching heat, Hellfire's intensity), SILK (harir — the fabric of Paradise), and FREEDOM (al-hurr = a free man vs. a slave; tahriru raqabah = freeing a slave; muharraran = a dedicated/released child). The freedom sense (8 of 15 occurrences) is internally coherent and even self-defines via its antonym 'slave.' But the heat sense (4) and silk sense (3) cannot be reduced to that freedom residue using only the verse evidence — nothing in "garments that guard you from the heat" or "their garment is silk" internally evokes release from bondage. Bridging heat, silk, and freedom would require outside etymology, which the rules forbid as evidence. Because whole clusters resist, universal presence fails.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: Form II (N(II): tahrir / muharraran) is the causative "make free / dedicate-release" and is cleanly separable — all 6 Form II occurrences sit in the freedom island. But separating form does NOT produce unity, because Form N by itself already spans all three islands: heat (16:81, 35:21, 9:81), silk (22:23, 35:33, 76:12), and free-person (2:178). Construction/participants further localize the freedom sense: raqabah (slave-neck) as object of tahrir; al-hurr paired against al-'abd. Context layers are legal (qisas retaliation 2:178; expiation/kaffara for manslaughter 4:92, zihar 58:3, broken oaths 5:89) versus vow/dedication (3:35) versus eschatological comfort (silk, shade). None of these context/form subtractions collapses heat and silk into the freedom residue.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 22:23 / 35:33 / 76:12 — harir (silk), a paradisal luxury fabric. It resists BOTH rival unifying hypotheses simultaneously: it carries no internal sense of "freedom/release" and no internal sense of "heat." A garment described only as fine cloth worn by the blessed offers nothing, on verse-internal grounds, that can be equated with either the free-vs-slave residue or the thermal residue. Silk therefore stands as an irreducible third island and single-handedly blocks universal presence.
internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: The most tempting unifier is an abstract "intensity / the pure, unburdened, finest essence": heat = intensity of thermal energy; free = the noble/unburdened person; silk = the fine/pure fabric; tahrir = releasing to a pure state. Under this reading all 15 might loosely align. It is rejected because (1) it rests on external lexicographic etymology (hurr al-wajh = the best part, hurr al-raml = pure sand), which is banned as evidence; (2) it is not falsifiable — "intensity/essence" is elastic enough to absorb almost anything; and (3) it is not internally attested: no verse links harr (heat) to purity or harir (silk) to release. A distinctive, non-empty residue must be readable from the occurrences themselves, and this one is not.
internal_discovery.distinctiveness_note: Within the freedom island the residue IS distinctive and falsifiable: al-hurr vs al-'abd (2:178) distinguishes it from mere 'itq synonyms by anchoring "free" as a legal-social status, and tahriru raqabah distinguishes the causative act. But this distinctiveness holds only for 8 occurrences. For the heat cluster the distinctive residue vs nearest roots would be thermal (contrast with zill = shade in 16:81/35:21), and for silk it is a material/fabric residue — three different, mutually non-overlapping distinctive cores. A single root contribution distinctive against nearest roots across ALL 15 cannot be stated without collapsing into vagueness, which forfeits distinctiveness.
unresolved_cases: Heat cluster (16:81, 35:21, 9:81 x2): thermal sensation/intensity, no internal path to a freedom or silk residue.
Silk cluster (22:23, 35:33, 76:12): paradisal fabric, resists both freedom and heat residues.
The three islands (heat / silk / freedom) share only the consonantal skeleton; no single internally-attested contribution subtracts to a non-empty residue present in every occurrence.
internal_discovery.rationale: Full coverage of all 15 confirmed occurrences yields three distinct semantic islands that cannot be reduced to one verse-internal contribution: HEAT (4: 16:81, 35:21, 9:81 x2), SILK (3: 22:23, 35:33, 76:12), and FREEDOM/RELEASE (8: 2:178 x2 free-person; 4:92 x3, 58:3, 5:89 freeing-slave; 3:35 dedicated-child). The freedom island is internally coherent and even self-defining via its antonym al-'abd, giving a real 8-occurrence residue "unbound/released from bondage." But the unity rule is non-negotiable and admits no majority: 7 occurrences across two whole clusters resist that residue on internal grounds, and any attempt to bridge them relies on forbidden external etymology and yields a non-falsifiable "intensity/essence" notion. Therefore universal presence does NOT hold and the result is UNRESOLVED rather than a forced single contribution.

adversarial_verification.notes: Universal presence does NOT hold. The proposed contribution "unbound / released from bondage — free" is demonstrably present only in an 8-occurrence sub-cluster: al-Hurr (2:178 x2, free vs slave al-'abd) and the Form II taHrir/muHarrar release cluster (3:35 muHarraran; 4:92 x3, 58:3, 5:89 taHriru raqabah = freeing a slave-neck). It is absent from 7 confirmed occurrences that split into two internally coherent domains with no freedom/release content even after allowing form/construction/context: HEAT — 16:81 (garments protecting from al-Harr), 35:21 (al-Harur, scorching wind), 9:81 x2 (marching in al-Harr / Hell being ashaddu Harran); SILK — 22:23, 35:33, 76:12 (Harir/Hariran, silk garment). The candidate's own statement concedes these 7. Under non-negotiable root unity, 7 unreconciled occurrences force verdict != SUPPORTED. The "release" residue is falsifiable (and here falsified) and is distinctive vs nearest freeing-roots within its cluster, but that is irrelevant to universality. No single stable contribution unifies heat + silk + freedom on internal evidence alone; the shared surface is only the consonantal skeleton H-r-r, not a demonstrable common semantic residue. Verdict: REFUTED.

occurrence_dispositions.note: HEAT island. al-Harr is a definite noun serving as direct object of taqikum ('garments that protect you from the heat'). Separating form (bare N), construction (object of protection verb), and participants (fabric garments, human wearers, ambient heat), the demonstrable residue is physical HEAT. Nothing in 'garments that guard you from the heat' internally evokes release-from-bondage/freedom; a bridge to the frozen freedom contribution would require external etymology, which is disallowed as evidence. Genuinely resists; not a Basmala artifact.

SILK island. Harir is the indefinite predicate noun of the nominal clause libasuhum fiha harir ('their garment therein is silk') in a Paradise-reward context. After subtracting form and participants (the believers, their clothing), the residue is a FABRIC (silk). There is no internal signal of unbinding/freeing; linking silk to release-from-bondage needs outside etymology, forbidden here. Genuinely resists; not a Basmala artifact.

al-Hurr in 'al-hurr bi-l-hurr', explicitly set against al-'abd (the slave) in the same clause. 'Free / unbound from bondage' is demonstrably present and self-defined by its antonym on internal evidence.
The paired al-Hurr in 'al-hurr bi-l-hurr'; same free-vs-slave (al-'abd) opposition. Release-from-bondage / free residue present internally.

HEAT island. al-Harur is an intensive N ('scorching heat / hot wind') set in explicit antithesis to al-zill ('the shade') in a paired negation (neither the shade nor the scorching heat). Residue after separating construction and the shade/heat contrast is HEAT. No internal foothold for freedom/release-from-bondage; bridging would require external etymology. Genuinely resists; not a Basmala artifact.

SILK island. Harir is the predicate noun of libasuhum fiha harir ('their garment therein is silk'), parallel to 22:23, in the Paradise adornment passage (bracelets of gold, pearls). Residue = FABRIC (silk). Nothing in the participants (dwellers of Eden, their garments) or construction evokes release-from-bondage; disallowed external etymology would be needed. Genuinely resists; not a Basmala artifact.

Muharraran (Form II passive ptcp): the mother vows the child in her womb as one made-free / released and dedicated to God, set apart from ordinary worldly claims. The 'released / freed' residue survives after subtracting the Form II construction, sharing it with the tahrir cluster on internal evidence.
tahriru raqabah = freeing a neck (a slave). Release from bondage is explicit; residue present after subtracting Form II verbal-noun construction.
Second tahriru raqabah in the same verse; freeing a slave-neck. Release-from-bondage residue present.
Third tahriru raqabah in the same verse; freeing a slave-neck. Release-from-bondage residue present.
tahriru raqabah as expiation before touching; freeing a slave-neck. Release from bondage demonstrably present.
tahriru raqabah among oath-expiation options; freeing a slave-neck. Release-from-bondage residue present.

SILK island. Harir(an) is an accusative object of jazahum ('He rewarded them with...'), coordinated with jannah ('a garden and silk'). After separating form and the reward construction, residue is FABRIC (silk). No internal evocation of freeing/unbinding; a link to the frozen freedom contribution requires forbidden external etymology. Genuinely resists; not a Basmala artifact.

HEAT island. al-Harr is a definite N governed by fi ('la tanfiru fi al-harr' — 'do not march out in the heat'), the hypocrites' excuse against the expedition. Residue after subtracting construction and participants is physical HEAT (weather/season). No internal freedom/release sense; bridging needs disallowed etymology. Genuinely resists; not a Basmala artifact.

HEAT island. Harr(an) is an accusative of specification (tamyiz) under the elative ashaddu ('the fire of Hell is more intense in heat'), predicated of Hellfire. Separating the elative construction and participants (Hellfire, its intensity) leaves the residue HEAT-intensity. No internal foothold for release-from-bondage/freedom; only forbidden external etymology could bridge. Genuinely resists; not a Basmala artifact.
